name: pipeline-orchestrator
description: Automated multi-agent pipeline. v4.9.2 (CI Debt + NIT-A): unblocks GitHub Actions Compat Regression CI for mock-mode-only environments without removing the safety guard for human use. Adds `--allow-templates-skipped` flag to `tests/compat/runner.cjs` — when paired with `--mock`, all-SKIPPED runs exit 0 with explicit warning instead of exit 1; without `--mock`, the flag is rejected with exit 2 (real-mode all-skipped is genuinely a problem). Updates `.github/workflows/compat-regression.yml` to pass the flag in the mock branch only (real-mode branch unchanged). Also clarifies the path-guard prose in `skills/spec-audit-only/steps/03-audit-loop.md` (NIT-A from v4.9.1 Batch 2 review): explicitly scopes Edit/Write to `.kiro/specs/<feature>/` and disambiguates other `docs/` references in body prose as documentation-only. Introduces `spec_context.uses_docs` optional boolean (default false) declared in `references/spec-context-schema.md` SSOT — widens audit-loop allowed-write set only when the spec explicitly opts in (deny-by-default). 3 new tests in `tests/unit/compat-runner.test.js` cover all 3 flag-combo scenarios (suite 73→76 green). v4.9.1 (Spec Workflow Polish): closes the 11 deferred non-blocking findings from the Wave 2 final adversarial review + 1 carryover NIT. Doc-only and frontmatter-only changes — zero runtime behavior change, zero new agents. Highlights: TD-01 reformat spec-heavy gates description to mirror spec-light rhythm; TD-02 add Execution-rules paragraph documenting `agent_type: ""` empty sentinel; TD-03 reconcile parallel/sequential conflict in spec-heavy steps 05/06/07 by removing parallelism encouragement (sequential expected_next chain stays); TD-04 add target-path guard in spec-audit-only step 03 + gate fixes_applied check in step 05 closure; TD-05 design note for audit-loop multi-concern collapse; TD-06+TD-07 MIRROR comment headers on sibling-DRY pairs (tdd-scenarios + content-review across spec-light/spec-heavy/spec-audit-only); TD-08 add `production_writes_allowed: false` to all 5 spec-audit-only step frontmatters + extend test (suite 72→73); TD-09+TD-10 cross-ref + max-rounds rationale comments on impl files; TD-11 extract repeated spec_context_schema block to new SSOT `references/spec-context-schema.md` (3 SKILL.md files now link instead of duplicate); plus N1 cleanup of stale 'sequencial ou paralelo' prose in spec-heavy/steps/08-confidence-dashboard.md. Pipeline-driven: 2 batches CLEAN no fix loops, 2/2 adversarial reviews PASS, sanity 8/8, Pa de Cal GO. v4.9.0 (Spec Workflow Import — Wave 2): imports 3 new prescriptive skill trees (`spec-light` 6 steps, `spec-heavy` 9 steps, `spec-audit-only` 5 steps) wiring the 4 Wave 1 spec lifecycle agents (spec-format-gate, spec-content-reviewer, spec-post-impl-validator, spec-closer) into end-to-end workflows. 23 new skill files + 4 new test files (+44 Wave 1 tests preserved = 72/72 green) + 4 new dispatch-guard.cjs entries registering the spec-* agents in the leaf-FQN whitelist. All step bodies are project-neutral (zero attribution markers, regex-verified). Frontmatter contract v4.7.0+ honored: every SKILL.md declares sequence_lock + gates_at + sentinel_checkpoints + stop_rule_max_failures, every step file declares execution_mode + agent_type + expected_inputs/outputs/next + gate_required + allowed_tools. Cross-cutting: corrects pre-existing namespace drift in 4 occurrences (FQDN: `pipeline-orchestrator:executor:type-specific:adversarial-{architecture-critic,security-scanner}` is canonical; `pipeline-orchestrator:quality:adversarial-*` was incorrect and has been removed). v4.8.0 (Hook Enforcement): adds shared `skill-frontmatter-parser.cjs` + extends 3 hooks (sentinel-hook, dispatch-guard, force-pipeline-agents) to enforce SKILL.md frontmatter contracts (sentinel_checkpoints, agent_type per step, gates_at) for all 6 backing skills (bugfix-{light,heavy} + audit-{light,heavy} + feature-{light,heavy}). 2-phase rollout: warn mode until 2026-05-17 (logs ENFORCEMENT_WARN to gate-decisions.jsonl with hardness AUDIT, does not block); deny mode auto-promotes after (blocks via permissionDecision=deny). Override via env `PIPELINE_ENFORCEMENT={warn,deny}`. Backward compat preserved: hooks skip enforcement when state.current_skill absent (advisory mode for non-skill flows). Resolves consolidated.md §17.4 #8. v4.7.0 (Slice 3b polish): completes the v4.6.1 correction with declarative frontmatter contract on all 26 step files (execution_mode + agent_type + expected_inputs/outputs/next + gate_required), full SKILL.md manifests for feature-light + feature-heavy (sequence_lock + gates_at + sentinel_checkpoints + stop_rule_max_failures), thin entry-point `skills/feature/SKILL.md` with --light/--heavy flag handling (mirrors audit/bugfix pattern), real workflow tests replacing placeholder Pulsar TESTS_USER_STORY content (moved to `references/feature-user-story-guidelines.md`), corrected deprecated headers in `references/pipelines/implement-{heavy,light}.md`, AGENTS.md roster count fix (38 → 19), and correction headers in spec/plan docs flagging v4.6.0/v4.6.1/v4.7.0 deltas. v4.6.1 (Slice 3b correction): reverts unified single-skill-with-mode-flag pattern to 2 separate skills (feature-light + feature-heavy) mirroring Pulsar canonical Heavy/ + Ligth/ folders 1:1. Same pattern as Slice 1.5 (bugfix) + Slice 3a (audit). v4.6.0 attempted unification but was reverted per dono — fonte canônica tem 2 pastas, port deve ter 2 skills. v4.6.0 (Slice 3b initial): imports prescriptive 13-step Pulsar Implement_new_feature workflow. v4.5.0 (Slice 3a): imports prescriptive 9-step Heavy + 9-step Light audit workflows from Pulsar as backing skills (audit-light, audit-heavy); /audit dispatches via --light/--heavy flags or auto-classify; report-only by Iron Law (no production writes); reuses existing audit-{intake,domain-analyzer,compliance-checker,risk-matrix-generator} agents; 8 enforcement rules + read-only invariant. v4.4.1 fix: deterministic Node wrapper for exec-window (scripts/exec-window/{open,close}.cjs) eliminates PIPELINE_LOCK_ACTIVE stalls. v4.4.0 (Slice 1.5): imports prescriptive 11-step Heavy + 8-step Light bugfix workflows from Pulsar as backing skills (bugfix-light, bugfix-heavy); /bugfix dispatches via --light/--heavy flags or auto-classify; closes 6 audit gaps (Heavy 3+9+11, Light 3+5+6) with 8 enforcement rules. v4.3.1 polish: review-driven cleanup of v4.3.0 skill migration. v4.3.0: /bugfix migrated commands/ → skills/ per official docs. v4.2.x: SEC patches + thin entry-points. v4 base: orchestration in isolated controller agent.
